description: This Java class 'FrameImage' manages image processing tasks related to product frame images, including uploading, combining images with overlays, previewing, and associating images with products within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FrameImage
classes.description: A utility class for managing product frame images, including uploading, combining, previewing, and associating images within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addImageFrame
methods.description: Handles adding a new image frame to a product, including image resizing, overlaying, and creating associated content and data resources.

methods.name: combineBufferedImage
methods.description: Combines two images into one BufferedImage with overlay and transparency effects.

methods.name: uploadFrame
methods.description: Processes uploading of a frame image, saves it to the server, and creates related content and data resource entries.

methods.name: previewFrameImage
methods.description: Generates a preview image by overlaying a frame onto a product image for display purposes.

methods.name: chooseFrameImage
methods.description: Selects an existing frame image and sets session attributes accordingly.

methods.name: deleteFrameImage
methods.description: Deletes the temporary preview image used for frame previewing.
